name: bld6_pi_dalzell_beta_bounds
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_integral_dalzell and Mathlib2.calc_integral_beta_nat: on (0,1) one has x^4(1-x)^4/2 < x^4(1-x)^4/(1+x^2) < x^4(1-x)^4; integrate (strict monotonicity of the interval integral for continuous functions). The middle integral is 22/7 - π by calc_integral_dalzell, the outer one is 4!4!/9! = 1/630 by calc_integral_beta_nat 4 4.
